args.rationale: Report is tightly focused on AAPL at 2026-07-31 and every quantitative claim traces to the frozen market CSV or the official earnings note. Price/volume/indicator figures (308.91 close, 333.43 prior close, −7.35%, 132.49M vs 74.82M, 10 EMA 327.24, Bollinger mid 324.37, RSI 45.08, MACD 6.82/8.14, ATR 9.90, day range 300.00–310.69) all match the observed tool outputs, and the earnings figures (revenue USD109.4bn +16%, GM 50.1% incl. ~2pp tariff refund, diluted EPS 2.02 +29% incl. 0.11 refund, dividend 0.27) match src-aapl exactly. Derived arithmetic (24.52 point drop, 1.77x volume, ex-refund 1.91 EPS / 48.1% margin, 5.4% refund share, 2.5x ATR) is correct and explicitly labeled as calculation. NO_DATA_AVAILABLE items (50/200 SMA, global news, macro, prediction markets) are correctly reported as unavailable rather than fabricated. Semantic validity holds: EPS 2.02 is consistently described as quarterly, the report explicitly refuses to compute a trailing P/E from single-quarter EPS, and no TTM/annual relabeling or unsupported valuation multiple appears anywhere. Minor deductions only for the slightly redundant multi-analyst repetition and a few judgment-based levels (305 soft trigger, 324.37 reclaim) that are clearly flagged as analyst judgment rather than sourced facts.
